Game Overview

In Alien Escape Run, the core idea is straightforward: maneuver your alien through treacherous terrains in Alien Escape Run, where every jump counts. Evade enemies, leap over obstacles, and collect gold to climb the leaderboard in this endless adventure. Timing is everything to master exciting enemy battles and assert your dominance as the ultimate alien runner.
